title: The failure of full reach at every power of two from 8
claim: Doubled coordinates of FULL-REACH-PROOF-20261108-001A (contacts (X, Y) of [0, N]^2, N = 2n - 2, X + Y odd; A[c, d] = 1 over GF(2) when c reads d). Proved: (1) (0, 1) reads only (1, 0), which is read only by (0, 1); for n >= 5, A^k[c*, (0, 1)] = A^k[(1, 0), d*] and A^(k+1)[c*, (1, 0)] = A^k[(1, 0), d*] with d* = (n + 3, n + 2), c* = (n + 2, n + 3); so if (1, 0) never reads d*, c* misses the corner ring and full reach fails; on the h contacts A^2 is the conveyor grid [0, n - 2] x [0, n - 1] (no step left on the bottom row, none right on the top row), so the failure at even n follows from (*): the conveyor walks from (0, 0) to (n/2 + 1, n/2 + 1) are even at every length. (2) sigma(X, Y) = (Y + 1, X - 1) is a symmetry of the free walk; G^B = G^(sigma B) for ends on the line X - Y = 1; mod 2 the walks between two points of the line are those whose every excursion lies above the line and touches X = 0 or Y = N, and in the plane only the empty walk and the single step from an h of the line to its neighbour survive. (3) The strip [0, N] x Z has det(lambda I - A(t)) = lambda U_(n-1)((lambda + t + 1/t)^2); at n = 2^m this is lambda (lambda + t + 1/t)^(2n-2): besides lambda = 0 one branch, the free walk in Y, with a period-4 eigenvector and one Jordan block; its decaying root at 1/w is w^2 C(w^4), C the Catalan series mod 2. (4) On the conveyor grid the anti-diagonal sums of xM, 0 <= s <= 2n - 3, are x(0, s + 1) + x(n - 2, s + 1 - n). Computed, exact: at every power of two from 4 to 128 the corner (0, 1) reads every contact but (X + 1, X), X = n + 2, n + 6, ..., 2n - 6, so (*) and A1 hold at 8 to 128; the corner return law 1/(1 + L(w^4)), L the trace polynomial of GF(2n), at 4 to 128; G_((0,1),(N,N-1)) = w^(4n-2) G_((0,1),(0,1)) at 4 to 128; below w^1200 the quadrant's return series is C(w^4) and the half-strips' equal it, and there the corner reads d*. The registered target A1, the failure at every power of two, is not proved: (*) is computed, not proved.
failure_conditions: A power of two n >= 8 at which (n + 2, n + 3) reads a contact of the corner ring (computed false at 8, 16, 32, 64).
A side 2^m at which the corner's return series is not 1/(1 + L(w^4)) (computed false at 4 to 32).
foundation_claim_scope: The square torus of rule-60 rings with equally spaced law-(12, 12) contacts, cut open by a ring of cuts each way (A30, A32, A37, A38); its walk over GF(2). Reach is a contact-level reading, so it does not depend on how the rings are declared beyond which contacts each ring holds (A45).
